# OpenSakura voice server (vendor/tts-engine/main.py), Python 3.11-3.12 (3.11 recommended; scipy, onnxruntime and
# matplotlib below need 3.11+). Linux wheels need glibc 2.28+; macOS needs 14+ on Apple Silicon (onnxruntime).
# Installed by scripts/setup_tts.py into vendor/tts-engine/.venv.
#
# torch==2.9.1 and torchaudio==2.9.1 are NOT listed here: setup_tts.py installs them first from the
# matching index (CUDA 12.8 on Windows/Linux with an NVIDIA GPU, CPU otherwise, PyPI on macOS) and holds
# them with a constraints file so nothing below can swap them for another build.
#
# This is the inference subset of upstream GPT-SoVITS requirements.txt at the pinned commit (b4570b87),
# plus packages the inference code imports that upstream only gets through its training / WebUI stack.
# Direct dependencies are pinned to the set tested on Windows 11 + RTX 5070 (2026-10-24); upstream's own
# constraint is noted where it has one. README.md lists what was left out and why.

# --- the server -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
python-socketio==5.17.0
aiohttp==3.14.5

# --- GPT-SoVITS inference (TTS_infer_pack and the modules it imports) -----------------------------
numpy==1.26.4                  # upstream: numpy<2.0
scipy==1.17.1
librosa==0.10.2                # upstream: ==0.10.2
numba==0.68.0
soundfile==0.14.0              # reference clips (main.py reads WAV with it when torchcodec is absent)
resampy==0.4.3                 # TTS.py resamples references with resampy's filter; not in upstream's list
ffmpeg-python==0.2.0           # imported by TTS.py
onnxruntime==1.31.0            # G2PW (Chinese polyphones) on CPU; upstream: onnxruntime-gpu on x86_64
transformers==4.57.6           # upstream: >=4.51,<5
peft==0.17.1                   # upstream: <0.18.0; imported by TTS.py
pytorch-lightning==2.6.6       # upstream: >=2.4; the GPT model class is a LightningModule
torchmetrics==1.5.0            # upstream: <=1.5
x-transformers==2.31.10        # module.models imports the v3/v4 DiT at import time
einops==0.8.2
matplotlib==3.11.2             # imported at module level by the AR learning-rate scheduler
rich==15.0.0                   # Accel (CUDA-graph AR) logging
loguru==0.7.3
PyYAML==6.0.3
psutil==7.2.2
tqdm==4.70.1
requests==2.34.2
huggingface_hub==0.36.2        # also used by setup_tts.py to download the gated voice

# --- text front-ends ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cn2an==0.5.24
pypinyin==0.55.0
jieba==0.42.1                  # jieba_fast has no wheels; main.py maps jieba_fast to jieba
OpenCC==1.4.2                  # upstream builds it from source (--no-binary); the wheels work
g2p_en==2.1.0
nltk==3.10.4
inflect==7.6.0
wordsegment==1.3.1
split-lang==2.1.1
fast_langdetect==1.1.0         # upstream: >=0.3.1
pyopenjtalk-plus==0.4.1.post10 # Japanese; drop-in for pyopenjtalk (sdist only), wheels + bundled dictionary
ToJyutping==3.2.0              # Cantonese
g2pk2==0.0.3                   # Korean
ko_pron==1.3
jamo==0.4.1
python_mecab_ko==1.3.7; sys_platform != 'win32'   # upstream marker
